core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: choose a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme onto the target and use the base change formula for the diagonal to transport the property of the diagonal to the presenting morphism (proof lines 509-525)
Apply the scheme-free equivalence: for the presenting morphism of algebraic spaces, quasi-separatedness is equivalent to the diagonal being quasi-compact and quasi-separated (proof lines 526-535)
Return to the stack: the criterion along the cover transfers the conclusion back, giving the equivalence for the original morphism (proof lines 536-542)
proof_roadmap: 取 V → Y 满光滑，令 U = X ×_Y V。
由 Δ 的基变换公式与沿覆盖检验性质的判据，把 Δ_f 的性质化为 Δ_{U/V} 的性质。
由代数空间层面的「准分离 ⟺ Δ 准紧且准分离」得结论，再沿覆盖回到栈。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces is quasi-separated exactly when its diagonal is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (author lemma at source lines 498-507, label lemma-representable-quasi-separated-diagonal-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 509-543) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, transports the property of the diagonal by the base change formula and the covering criterion, applies the corresponding equivalence for algebraic spaces and returns to the stack (proof lines 509-542). The reduction through the presentation is the substance. H3.
